pages.title: A água chegou cedo
pages.scene: At Folealto north eight-paddle wheel, Vessa compares the rising gauge to yesterday's mark and sends a measured reading south by an anonymous courier seen from behind. Rain clouds gather. Top wide village view; lower measured close-up. No other named person.

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: Subiu dois dias antes do cálculo. Leve a medida à Escada.

pages.title: Estacas na margem leste
pages.scene: Braka at Pedra-Verde east sluice sees water reach the foot of its timber stakes. West bridge behind. A mounted unnamed courier departs at dawn with her reading toward the amber village; she does not open the gate. Wide river panel, tall figure panel and narrow gauge detail.

lines.speaker: Braka
lines.text: A comporta resiste. A margem leste, não por muito tempo.

pages.title: Duas medidas
pages.scene: At the amber public memory room, Talin receives two separately sealed measurements from Folealto and Pedra-Verde, compares them at the cedar table, then lifts the small meeting bell. Two west windows, north shelves, south spiral door.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Chamem o conselho. A nascente e a margem leste subiram juntas.

pages.title: Licença com limites
pages.scene: Eda arrives on foot, rain-wet blue-teal cloak, and presents the municipal permit to Talin at the same cedar table. The document authorizes inspection and gradual pressure relief only with three-community readings and assent. No instant jump.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Posso autorizar a vistoria. Não posso entregar a margem de ninguém.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Então leremos as condições diante de todos.

pages.title: Seis assinaturas
pages.scene: In the public memory room, Talin reads the permit aloud and Braka marks the condition for an orc observer at each sluice adjustment; six signatures are gathered in distinct hands without unreadable invented text. No intervention yet.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Nenhuma abertura sem leitura das três margens.

lines.speaker: Braka
lines.text: E uma pessoa de Pedra-Verde ficará na comporta.

pages.title: O testemunho da nascente
pages.scene: Vessa has followed the dawn courier south along the ordinary road from Folealto and reaches amber council after a half-day walk. At cedar table she draws before-and-after columns for the village witness who will remain at the north eight-paddle wheel. The witness is only mentioned, not shown; no teleport.

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: Anotem o fluxo antes e depois. Sem número, não há acordo.

pages.title: Lanternas na rua baixa
pages.scene: Adra and Ilyan walk the lower street of the amber village, marking lantern route from doorways to higher stone steps. Adra carries ferry signal cloth; Ilyan carries a household list. Distinct adult residents small in background, no Nima.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: A balsa espera no cais; as lanternas levam às escadas.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Vou conferir cada casa antes do anoitecer.

pages.title: A panela no fogo
pages.scene: Ilyan knocks at a low house. It is empty except for a pot over a banked hearth. A neighbor, seen only as an anonymous silhouette, points toward the high garden where the family works. Ilyan marks 'location confirmed' on his own list; no false missing-person alarm.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Na horta alta. Não vou mandar ninguém procurá-los aqui.

pages.title: A cadeira firme
pages.scene: Talin checks the higher staircase; Ilyan and two unnamed adult villagers test a solid wooden carrying chair for the elderly woman of the low street, not moving her yet. Clear handholds and direction uphill. Village faces do not replace main characters.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Testem a escada com a cadeira vazia primeiro.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Depois saberei onde meus braços precisam ficar.

pages.title: A junta sob o leito
pages.scene: At the sealed lateral intake north of amber village, Runa and Vessa inspect copper joint and water seep from outside the permitted boundary. Vessa compares real slope with Varek's drawing. The part is still installed and tagged; neither opens it.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: A água força esta junta, não a linha do desenho.

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: O reparo ergueu a tomada lateral. Registre o desvio.

pages.title: Efeito, não motivo
pages.scene: Close technical comic of the same copper joint, Vessa's ruler and Runa's faithful sketch, with a narrow upper panel of their faces. Three recorded community levels match timing of the road work, but intention remains unknown.

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: Isto mostra o efeito da obra.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Para provar a decisão, faltam ordens e testemunhas.

pages.title: O livro incompleto
pages.scene: Back at the amber cedar table, Varek in ochre contractor coat sets down execution book for Eda. Visible purchase pages and a dated earlier gauge, but the later reading slot is empty. Two west windows and north shelves remain consistent.

lines.speaker: Varek
lines.text: Fui eu que construí. Não deixem estranhos girar a roda.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: A leitura posterior não está neste livro.

pages.title: Ressalva escrita
pages.scene: Eda notes the missing reading without inventing its value; Braka stands at same council table, reminding that builder authority does not erase local consent. Varek is off-panel, not duplicated. Eda opens a separate space for his written objection.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: A ressalva dele ficará junto das folhas que faltam.

lines.speaker: Braka
lines.text: Construir não dispensa perguntar a quem mora abaixo.

pages.title: Um quarto de volta
pages.scene: Split location panels: Vessa places temporary markers beside old intake north of amber village; Braka stays at her own EAST Pedra-Verde sluice with an agreed red signal cloth. They agree on very short test intervals and immediate stop if Pedra-Verde rises. They are not standing together and no water is released yet.

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: Um quarto de volta por vez. Recuamos se a sua marca subir.

lines.speaker: Braka
lines.text: Meu sinal virá da comporta, não da sua mesa.

pages.title: Permissão para testar
pages.scene: Six signed approvals at cedar table are read aloud. Talin checks municipal and three-community conditions; Adra folds the agreed evacuation route beside the test authorization. No victory pose, merely permission for limited operation.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Só o teste curto está autorizado.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: A rota de saída fica pronta mesmo que não a usemos.

pages.title: O que uma mão alcança
pages.scene: On covered porch outside amber memory room at night, Runa and Ilyan study a wet scale by two lanterns. Her ink-stained tattooed left arm and his blunt copper-guard sword remain visible. She admits magic can guide present water briefly but cannot hold a hillside. Quiet closeness without a kiss.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Tem medo de a magia falhar amanhã?

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Tenho mais medo de chamarem magia de desculpa para medir mal.

pages.title: Quatro horas
pages.scene: Runa touches the scabbard of Ilyan's blunt training sword, then leads him toward guest stair while night watch changes in background. They each retain seventeen-year-old faces and established clothes. He accepts rest before duty; mutual regard, no kiss.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: A lâmina pode segurar uma haste, não vencer a enchente.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Você vai dormir quatro horas. Não três.

pages.title: Três números sob chuva
pages.scene: Heavy rain on amber village. Vessa compares the first soaked readings from Folealto and Pedra-Verde with the temporary amber gauge, each marked by place and time. Eda records the difference in travel lag. Messengers are hooded silhouettes, no invented faces.

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: As três marcas sobem. Cada trecho responde em seu tempo.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Vou registrar as horas antes de autorizarmos o giro.

pages.title: Panos na balsa
pages.scene: Adra stands on amber village riverside dock and uses two colored cloth signals to confirm ferry and uphill evacuation path. Ferry has one operator and remains tethered. Rain visible; low houses behind, no unsafe crossing yet.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Balsa presa. Quando o sino tocar, sigam as lanternas.

pages.title: Linha entre os postes
pages.scene: Sere, dark-skinned young elf with one long silver-white braid and forest cloak, fires one rope-tipped arrow into a dead post to establish a guide line across rain-lashed intake path. Bow recurved ash, no attack on creature. Clear action sequence with arrow path and secured cord.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: A corda marca o caminho de volta!

pages.title: Água já presente
pages.scene: Runa near intake guides only existing surface water in shallow ditch away from the workers' feet. Her long straight black hair with blunt bangs, silver septum, floral left-arm tattoo and dark plum medieval outfit remain exact. Her left arm trembles from effort, no spectacular new spell.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Só a vala rasa. Não controlo o rio inteiro.

pages.title: Primeira fração
pages.scene: Under rain at old intake, Vessa turns authorized wheel by one small fraction; Talin watches measured amber mark, ash staff bracing his footing. Show mechanism and same copper joint, not a new machine. Operation is reversible and slow.

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: Primeiro intervalo. Anote a marca.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: O sino ainda não respondeu.

pages.title: O sinal de Braka
pages.scene: At Pedra-Verde EAST sluice, Braka sees her gauge rise faster than permitted and raises the agreed red signal cloth toward distant intake observers. She does not abandon station. Three-braid dark-olive orc captain, chipped tusk, red cloak, rain over armor. Narrow detail of threatening marker.

lines.speaker: Braka
lines.text: Fechem um quarto. A minha margem subiu!

pages.title: O bronze responde
pages.scene: A pressure pulse drives an old metal arm against stone and lifts the automatic bell clapper. The old bell rings through rain over amber village for the first time witnessed by Talin. Giant bell action splash with small inset Talin looking uphill; no person touches cut manual rope.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: É o alarme antigo! As casas baixas, agora!

pages.title: Subida pela luz
pages.scene: Lantern route up amber village stone stairs in rain. Two unnamed adult bearers carry previously tested chair with elderly villager and her blanket; Ilyan clears front stair, Adra directs ferry families behind. Faces distinct, no sudden child Nima, no empty house mistaken for missing family.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Devagar no degrau molhado. Temos tempo para todos.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: A última casa foi conferida. Continuem subindo.

pages.title: O lacre solto
pages.scene: At rain-soaked intake door, Eda finds seal loosened, Varek with his leather folder and an unnamed contractor worker. The external authorized key cabinet is visible separate from inner archive compartment. Eda observes before accusing; she does not turn him into a confessed mastermind.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Hora, porta e testemunhas. Ninguém toca mais no selo.

lines.speaker: Varek
lines.text: Entrei por uma folha. Quero explicar o que ela mostra.

pages.title: A folha retida
pages.scene: Eda seals Varek's retrieved measurement sheet as evidence in rain shelter. Vessa points to external cabinet where inspection key actually was. Distinguish preserving proof from proving sabotage. Varek is off-panel and not duplicated. Bell still sounds distant.

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: A chave estava no armário externo.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: A folha fica comigo. Ele responderá por escrito.

pages.title: A haste salta
pages.scene: Same old intake wheel jerks under pressure. An ancient iron arm swings across narrow exit toward short adult gnome Vessa; Ilyan, long-haired beardless adolescent with blunt short sword, notices and steps between. Dynamic action, clear spatial trajectory, no actual impact yet.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Vessa, abaixe-se!

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: A trava secundária fica atrás da haste!

pages.title: Espada sem fio
pages.scene: Ilyan braces his ordinary blunt short training sword with simple copper guard against swinging iron rod ONE time to shield Vessa, not magically defeat mechanism. Rain, effort, wrist pain, blade develops a small burr. Dynamic full-page combat-like defense with one figure, anatomically sound, no glowing magic sword.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Segurei por um instante. Só isso!

pages.title: Corda e gancho
pages.scene: Sequential action: Sere tensions the established rope through safety pulley; Adra hooks a ferry cable to the line dropped by an anonymous worker. Same old intake wheel, no teleported ferry. Their coordinated physical forces keep iron rod from whipping back; Ilyan is off-panel.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Prendi a roldana! Adra, o cabo!

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Gancho firme. Agora a trava!

pages.title: Um dente de recuo
pages.scene: At intake, Vessa reaches secondary latch while Talin braces her boot on stone with ash staff. A background distant signal from Braka at her EAST sluice confirms quarter closure; Braka is not present in the intake panel. Old iron rod retreats ONE tooth, not a new mechanism.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Pedra-Verde confirmou o fechamento!

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: Mais um dente. Mantenham o cabo tenso.

pages.title: Por baixo do desenho
pages.scene: Runa feels new pressure surge from UNDER the mapped channel; she withdraws her hand from shallow water rather than forcing magic, visibly exhausted tattooed arm. Vessa takes new reading and understands source from below. Copper joint and field scale remain consistent.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Vessa! A pressão veio por baixo da junta!

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: Recuem. Abriremos o alívio menor na vala preparada.

pages.title: A vala preparada
pages.scene: Vessa and Eda adjust previously approved smaller relief toward EMPTY prepared ditch while road intake closes in stages. Distant Pedra-Verde timber bridge remains intact; no water pushed into occupied homes. Eda records two community figures. Technically plausible action with same markers.

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: Desvio menor. A ponte continua fora da corrente.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Folealto e Pedra-Verde confirmaram a leitura.

pages.title: O silêncio não basta
pages.scene: Rain thins. Old automatic bell rings twice more with measured pressure, then falls silent. Talin listens beneath bell, Adra checks empty low houses from hillside. No cheering or residents descending yet. Wide bell sky and two close details, distinct positions.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Duas batidas, duas marcas anotadas.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Silêncio não significa que as casas estejam seguras.

pages.title: Turnos de descanso
pages.scene: Inside amber village covered shelter at night, Ilyan's sore WRIST is bandaged, blunt sword has a small burr and stays sheathed; Runa's tattooed LEFT forearm cramps after limited water magic. Both retain seventeen-year-old features. They rest by turns, no sudden healing or romance leap.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Meu braço vai descansar antes de outra medida.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: A espada também precisa de ferreiro. E eu, de sono.

pages.title: Todos contados
pages.scene: Adra counts people, animals and ferries at high shelter while Ilyan writes down elderly woman's question whether her house foundation survived. He promises an inspection at dawn, no false reassurance. Sere's single lost arrow marked on inventory. Residents remain upstairs.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Pessoas e animais, conferidos. Uma flecha se perdeu.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: A casa dela será vistoriada ao amanhecer.

pages.title: Antes do retorno
pages.scene: Clear morning after storm. Talin inspects low street bridge and foundations before any family descends; Vessa measures stabilized intake gauge. Show a simple inspection route from stone stair down to houses, no crowd returning prematurely. Brown mud and damage remain.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Primeiro pontes e alicerces. Depois chamamos as famílias.

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: A tomada mantém o ajuste combinado.

pages.title: Nomes e reparos
pages.scene: Families return after inspection to muddy low street; Adra opens public repair list with owners, costs and possible responsible parties; Braka names damaged stakes on her side separately. Show cleaned but not magically restored houses, no loss of lives and some lost provisions.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Cada casa terá nome, dano e responsável pela vistoria.

lines.speaker: Braka
lines.text: E Pedra-Verde entregará a conta de suas estacas.

pages.title: Três registros
pages.scene: At same cedar council table, Eda keeps three separate records: Varek's authorization for road work; measured effect of lateral intake; and his attempt to remove a sheet through broken seal. Varek, still pale with short ash-blond hair, sparse beard and ochre contractor coat, receives chance to answer; no invented confession about cut bell rope.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: A obra, seu efeito e o lacre são fatos distintos.

lines.speaker: Varek
lines.text: Vou responder sobre cada folha. Não aceito outra culpa sem prova.

pages.title: Oito dentes
pages.scene: Vessa diagrams old automatic alarm: EIGHT-toothed wheel raises bell clapper as float receives pressure. Cut manual rope remains separate unresolved investigation. Talin orders both automatic and manual connections repaired. Show mechanical detail and a council glance.

lines.speaker: Vessa
lines.text: O flutuador ergue o badalo. A corda cortada não causou o toque.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Consertem os dois caminhos. Quem cortou a corda ainda não sabemos.

pages.title: A margem tem endereço
pages.scene: Runa lays three public gauge readings in distinct ink colors across cedar table; Adra writes names of inhabited banks and their homes onto a public map. Braka's corrected place name already incorporated, she is off-panel. Respect amber room west windows and north shelves. Quiet victory of civic record.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Três tintas, três medidas. Nenhuma apaga a outra.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: A água tem saída porque estas casas têm endereço.

pages.title: A curva de Mira
pages.scene: After meeting in same public memory room, Talin shows Ilyan an OLD survey by his absent mother Mira, no portrait or apparition. Its curved line continues WEST beyond school map; later unsigned note says bank changed course. Dates show old survey precedes disappearance. Ilyan does not infer she is alive.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: A curva segue a oeste. A nota posterior não tem assinatura.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Quem conhece esse caminho? Quanto tempo leva chegar lá?

pages.title: Cartas antes da estrada
pages.scene: At amber village sheltered table, Ilyan writes separate letters to Bram and Nima in Pedra-Mansa about flood and Mira's westward old line; Nima is NOT physically present. Runa sees map but keeps her own notebook. Neither sets out tonight; Ilyan's wrist bandage persists.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Bram e Nima vão saber o que houve, sem eu me fazer de herói.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Se perguntarmos pelo oeste, vou por minhas razões também.

pages.title: Estradas que ficam
pages.scene: Final arc-three portrait splash at amber stepped fountain under wooden awning after storm. Lower water carries leaves; repaired village lanterns shine up hill. Ilyan, long black wavy-haired beardless seventeen-year-old with bandaged wrist and blunt sword, stands beside Runa, long STRAIGHT black bangs, septum and floral left-arm tattoo. Both look WEST toward a distant ordinary road, not toward a portal. They remain distinct people, gently close but not kissing. Curved old map held between them. The valley homes are safe after communal work, Mira's fate open. Leave generous dusk sky in top corners for two compact balloons, faces fully visible.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Quis ser guerreiro para proteger um caminho. Agora sei para quem.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Então vamos ouvir quem vive no próximo.
